item.title: PulmoDataSets Package 📦📦📦
item.description:
https://preview.redd.it/zro8h1bdhv4f1.png?width=518&format=png&auto=webp&s=361424f5942b3f458f9d38537de908b57de976c5
The **PulmoDataSets** package offers a thematically rich and diverse collection of datasets focused on the **lungs, respiratory system, and associated diseases**. It includes data related to chronic respiratory conditions such as **asthma, chronic bronchitis, and COPD**, as well as infectious diseases like **tuberculosis, pneumonia, influenza, and whooping cough**. [https://lightbluetitan.github.io/pulmodatasets/](https://lightbluetitan.github.io/pulmodatasets/)
